newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks ease before weekend on unloading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks ease before weekend on unloading.

text.p: Pakistani stocks eased on Friday as jobbers unloaded speculative scrips before the Saturday and Sunday weekend, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The Karachi 100-share index eased 0.22 point to 1,547.49 in the first 90 minutes of trade.
Jobbers usually unload speculative stocks before the weekend, dealer Ali Raza said.
Hub Power Company Ltd eased 0.10 to 37.80 and ICI Pakistan 0.15 to 24.70 at 11.02 a.m. (0602 GMT).
